question: For patients with alkaliphophatase (ALP) within normal range, were they treated as inpatient or outpatient?
statements:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "conductor_s_execution" AS
WITH labs AS (
    SELECT CAST(id AS VARCHAR) AS id, date, alp
    FROM labs_from_table_2
    WHERE alp IS NOT NULL AND alp BETWEEN 44 AND 147
),
enc_text AS (
    SELECT id, encounter_text
    FROM text_from_table_1
),
enc AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        CASE
            WHEN encounter_text ILIKE '%inpatient%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%in-patient%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%ipd%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%inpt%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%admission%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%admit%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%admitted%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%hospitalized%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '% ward%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '% ward %'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '% er %'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '% ed %'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '% emergency %'
            THEN 'inpatient'
            WHEN encounter_text ILIKE '%outpatient%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%out-patient%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%opd%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%outpt%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '% clinic%'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '% clinic %'
                 OR encounter_text ILIKE '%ambulatory%'
            THEN 'outpatient'
            ELSE 'unknown'
        END AS encounter_type
    FROM enc_text
),
patients_with_normal AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id FROM labs
),
assignments AS (
    SELECT p.id, COALESCE(e.encounter_type, 'unknown') AS encounter_type
    FROM patients_with_normal p
    LEFT JOIN enc e ON e.id = p.id
),
counts AS (
    SELECT encounter_type, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS patient_count
    FROM assignments
    GROUP BY encounter_type
),
Total AS (
    SELECT SUM(patient_count) AS total FROM counts
)
SELECT 
    encounter_type,
    patient_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * patient_count / NULLIF(total, 0), 1) AS pct_of_normal_patients
FROM counts CROSS JOIN Total
ORDER BY patient_count DESC, encounter_type;
